verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents that composition functions can be written in Python and Go, as well as YAML and KCL. Its official CLI can build, test and render functions locally without a cluster. Together these suggest first-party programmatic building blocks for extending the product, but the pack never names an official SDK or describes its APIs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDK libraries (e.g. Go/Python function SDKs) with API references, language coverage beyond function authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
